name: Cera Sanitaryware Limited
summary: Cera Sanitaryware Limited manufactures, sells, and trades in building material products in India. The company offers sanitaryware, including toilets, wash basins, cisterns, seat covers, and fittings; faucets, showers, health faucets, allied products, and bath accessories; urinals; special needs bathroom products, shower chairs, and grab bars and handrails; green bathroom products; floor and wall tiles; shower partitions; kitchen sinks; bathtubs; and vanity cabinets and mirrors under the Senator, CERA Luxe, CERA, and Polipluz brands.
